current_scope.direct_comparison: exactly two persons or teams, same RaceEdition

event_extensions: participant.entity may be person or team.
Team member order must never be promoted to a verified relay-leg assignment.
2026 is currently the only RaceEdition; cross-edition comparison must remain dormant until a later edition is source-bound and explicitly comparable.
must_preserve: Nine analytical segments for 75 km and four for 35 km; auxiliary points must not become segment boundaries.
Current team/relay class metadata and non-competitive class handling.
Whole-course and segment comparison keys for future CourseVersion changes.
Existing 2-5 entity Kartduell, music and synchronized elevation.
migration_priorities: Embed a shared-clock two-entity replay directly inside Head-to-head using existing map/replay primitives.
Synchronize checkpoint/segment selection with map, elevation and race clock.
Align playback to 30/60/120/180 second duration choices, 120-second default and 30% neutral audio volume.
Enable race soundtrack and persisted audio preferences in Head-to-head.
Replace coarse follow-camera cadence with the shared smooth-follow behavior while preserving map fit modes.
Add sparse fallback support for future editions with incomplete checkpoint coverage without changing 2026 analytics.
Keep cross-edition comparison disabled until 2027 or later data is explicitly registered and comparable.
acceptance_gates: 2026 canonical totals remain 607 results and 4,059 passages.
Individual and relay Head-to-head both retain correct participant.entity semantics.
No auxiliary/display timing point becomes an analytical segment boundary.
Browser tests cover person/person, team/team and Kartduell handoff.
Future-edition capability logic remains explicit and does not infer comparability from family name alone.
